Title: Instruction sur les estats d'oraison, où sont exposées les erreurs des faux mystiques de nos jours, avec les actes de leur condamnation (seconde édition)
Creator: Jacques-Bénigne Bossuet, bishop of Meaux
Publisher: A Paris, [Jean Anisson, directeur de l'Imprimerie] Royale, rue de la Harpe, à la Fleur-de-Lis de Florence (the printer's name is not legible in the scan's OCR)
Publication Date: 1697
Rights: Public Domain (published 1697, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item's own rights statement reads 'http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/')
Language: fra
Source: Internet Archive item bub_gb_5fYxQoDiPJIC (https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_5fYxQoDiPJIC), the item's own bub_gb_5fYxQoDiPJIC_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: National Central Library of Rome; host metadata date: 1697. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 5467217ac7a5f69b0462b9aa8151db184c7f482537fd5febc88efe1c531a1617.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. National Central Library of Rome copy scanned by Google and contributed to the Internet Archive; good OCR, long s as f, marginal summaries interleaved.
Content note: Bossuet's doctrinal treatise against the 'false mystics', published in 1697 against Guyon and in answer to Fénelon's Maxims, in ten books, with the acts of condemnation (the ordinances of the archbishop of Paris and the bishops of Meaux, Châlons and Chartres) listed at the front and printed with it.
